## Summary

A swap pitch: "99% of people taking pregabalin and phenibut as a 'social lubricant' would be better off ditching it for mexidol — hell even those who feel they need alcohol to perform in social situations." Claimed mechanism stack for mexidol (emoxypine succinate): reduces social friction, improves mood/confidence; BBB-crossing antioxidant; protects neurons under stress, hypoxia, stimulant use; stabilizes cell membranes → improved glutamate/GABA ratio; anxiolytic without sedation ("no retard sedation"); mitochondrial support (more ATP); used in Russia for stroke recovery, TBI, cognitive decline; reduces oxidative brain fog; enhances memory consolidation. Closer: "pairs fucking wonderfully with stims if you get a bit jittery." The photo box (Mexiprim 125 mg) matches the dose lane Zygomatic ran.

## Why it matters

- The **real idea worth keeping** is the harm-reduction frame: pregabalin and phenibut are dependence-liability GABAergics (phenibut notoriously so), and alcohol is alcohol — proposing a non-sedating antioxidant instead is directionally sane *for people not already dependent*.
- Cross-checks inside the vault: Zygomatic's ADHD-replacement article ([[2026-11-10-zygomatic03-pinealon-social-fluidity]]) already profiles mexidol at 125 mg near-daily — "soft lock-in, warmth, light anxiolysis" — and carries the two cautions this tweet omits: it **potentiates benzos/sedatives**, and it's contraindicated in liver/kidney dysfunction. His article also found mexidol can tip an already-full social stack into over-stimulation.
- Skepticism gates, in order: (1) **the swap is dangerous for regular users** — phenibut and pregabalin withdrawal are medically serious (seizures, rebound anxiety); anyone actually on them daily needs a taper, not a substitution tweet. The "99% better off" line is unfounded — no head-to-head vs pregabalin for social anxiety exists. (2) **Evidence base is Russian-pharma**: emoxypine's human data is mostly Soviet/Russian stroke/TBI literature; Western RCT support is thin. (3) The bullet stack is mechanism-marketing — every claim is plausible-from-animal-or-Russian-studies, none is established at the "social lubricant" claim level. (4) Same affiliate-flavored author as the modvigil-200 endorsement ([[2026-11-17-basedbiohacker-modvigil-200]]) — product-photo tweets are his format.
- UAE posture unchanged: mexidol/Mexiprim is not a UAE-registered pharmacy item as far as captured — same gray-import lane and cautions as the rest of the thread ([[2026-11-17-zygomatic03-daily-stack-t3-meldonium]]). Reference-only, no task — thread posture stays checking, not ordering.
